pocket-step-accuracy.notes: Count 200 steps independently. Record detected count, percentage error, speed and placement. Target <=10% step error; repeat if not met.

locked-walk-distance.notes: Confirm the same session ran uninterrupted through the start/end screenshots. Walk for at least 30 locked minutes. Record pad/app start/end distance deltas before correction and calibration status. Target <=15% distance error after personal calibration at the tested speed. Retain locked-walk.json and screenshots.

notification-finish.notes: Warm and cold Activity: tap notification Finish. Verify paused review and no automatic save. Cancel remains paused. Old notification cannot affect a new session.

pause-resume.notes: Paused steps/time excluded; resume records again and labels partial estimate. Capture before/after diagnostics.

single-save-walking-totals.notes: Save once; Walks contains one entry; running mileage unchanged. Capture before/after totals and saved distance provenance.

interrupted-recovery.notes: Separate test: process death and reboot recover checkpoint without invented missing steps or duplicate saves. Do not force-stop as a substitute for process death.
